To better understand this effect, the researchers attempted to fit a mixed-effect negative binomial regression model for the same roadways for daytime crashes. However, although a large variety of optimization techniques were used, SAS could not reach a solution for the mixed model. Due to this reason, the team developed a fixed-effect daytime crash model (Table 21) for comparison. In addition, the research team fitted a mixed-effect negative binomial regression model of nighttime (after midnight) crashes (Table 22) and another for daytime crashes (Table 23) both for the before LED period and the same roadway types.
